complete_audit_evidence.explanation: The 6 moderate vulnerabilities reside in optional dependency paths (@google-cloud/storage -> retry-request -> teeny-request). Because proxy/Dockerfile explicitly executes 'npm ci --omit=dev --omit=optional', @google-cloud/storage is completely excluded from production container images and deployed runtimes.

advisories.mitigation: Excluded from production container build via --omit=optional in proxy/Dockerfile. Direct Firestore SDK used for runtime database operations.
